versions.changelog: v3.0.0: Complete rewrite with real functionality.
v2.5 standard: Use-when desc, homepage, source, security fix
Standards compliance: unique content, no template text
Fixed: aligned documentation with implementation, added missing commands
Quality fixes: removed third-party references, aligned docs with implementation
Enhanced descriptions for better AI triggering

- Removed the file "tips.md" to clean up documentation.
- No other user-facing changes in features or usage.

Initial release of Liquidity Monitor for DEX pools.

- Real-time pool tracking across major EVM and Solana DEXes.
- Impermanent loss calculator with historical and scenario modeling.
- LP yield estimator including fee and farming reward projections.
- Alert system for liquidity risk events (e.g., rug pulls, large swaps).
- Pool analytics: health score, volume/liquidity metrics, and provider tracking.
- Command-line usage support and HTML dashboard generation.
